elements-skip-link--hidden.name: Hidden
elements-skip-link--hidden.description: The skip link before it gets focus: hidden from sight, but still in the accessibility tree.

elements-skip-link--focus.name: Focus
elements-skip-link--focus.description: The skip link with focus, the look Penpot draws.

elements-skip-link--target.name: Target
elements-skip-link--target.description: The target with focus once the skip link moved focus to it, the look of the Target board in Penpot.

elements-skip-link--on-page.name: On Page
elements-skip-link--on-page.description: The skip link as the first focusable item of a page. Press Tab in the story to show it, then Enter to skip.
